trickyParts: outputs: type=image,…,push-by-digest=true replaces push and tags on the per-leg build; push beside outputs would request a second exporter.
Digests travel as artifacts envoy-image-digest-<arch> (not legion-envoy-*, which release_publish copies into the release assets); matrix job outputs keep only the last leg.

image_index takes the index digest from imagetools create --metadata-file (containerimage.descriptor.digest), never back through the mutable tag; imagetools keeps both legs' attestation manifests (proven).
cache-to is '' off refs/heads/main, so a branch dispatch reads the cache and never writes it.
deviations: Spec v3 (2026-10-27) replaced the plan's type=gha,scope=envoy-<arch> cache with a ghcr.io registry cache per leg (buildcache-<arch>), written only on main (commit c6c38f15).

To measure a cache hit before the merge, two temporary commits (2444de11, 17fa916a) let the branch write buildcache-<arch> once; 0fb74300 reverts them (file identical to c6c38f15). The first temporary head's run was cancelled before any docker leg ran, so no buildcache-<arch>-infra-522-measure tag exists.

The two cache versions the branch wrote (GHCR versions 1452457314 buildcache-arm64, 1452720428 buildcache-amd64) could not be deleted: the implement App gets 403 'Resource not accessible by integration' on DELETE users/sjawhar/packages/container/legion%2Fenvoy/versions/<id>. main's first run moves both tags to a main-written cache.
The simplify pass ran at 57fff226, before the cache commit; that commit changes only cache lines, in #2316's pattern.
openQuestions: A2 (7-day main median of the slower docker leg < 8 min) is proven in the production check, as the architect accepted; the branch numbers (hit 3.58, miss+write 6.38) predict it.
discoveredComplexity: The account's x64 runner queue (about 124 queued runs on 2026-10-27) made every x64 job wait 30-70 min; arm64 jobs started within minutes. docker still needs build (the archive matrix), so a release run waits for two x64 queue slots before the amd64 leg.
